! Type this first, on dev-cisco-synthetic-system-stray, and check the name:   show version | include uptime

!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-synthetic-system-stray !!!!!
configure terminal
! aaa: the method lists tacctl renders, each replaced by the rendered line
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
! snmp: the SNMP block of scope 'lab' (its communities, access lists, trap hosts, trap source and 'enable traps' lines)
snmp-server trap-source Loopback0
! system: the statements of the system block of scope 'lab'
banner login ^
Authorized use only.
! Activity is logged.
^
ip domain name lab.example.net
clock timezone CET 1
ntp trusted-key 5
ntp server 192.0.2.123 version 4 key 5 prefer
ntp authenticate
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
line con 0
 login authentication CONSOLE
end
!!!!! PASTE TO HERE: dev-cisco-synthetic-system-stray !!!!!
